_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Test Progress Report
summary: Outlines progress in achieving performance objectives at every level of testing on systems or equipment and provides the procuring activity with the test progress status.
use_relationship:
The Test Progress Report outlines progress in achieving performance objectives at every level of testing on systems or equipment. It provides the procuring activity with the test progress status.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work/Performance Work Statement.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Progress Report shall be organized into the following sections:

children.title: Scope
children.content: This section shall be divided into the following sub-sections:

children.title: All test articles with a schedule and list of tests including test sequence, and status for each test in tabular form
Description of each test and all significant data obtained
Detail of test results, conclusions, reinforcements, modifications and necessary changes to test assets
Spectrum progress at the time of report
Design conditions and maximum loads attained
Modifications to test articles
children.content: All modifications to the test articles to permit attainment of test loads, not previously covered in the description of test articles report, shall be described, including photographs and sketches as appropriate.

children.title: Test summaries consisting of supplemental pages
children.content: including a discussion of test results, conclusions, discussion of compliance with specification requirements, deficiencies disclosed, reinforcements, the flight or production articles in which reinforcements will or will not be incorporated, the effect of the test on the test program, flight program, evaluation of the weapons system, and delivery of the aircraft.

children.title: Significant achievements
children.content: the attainment of significant achievements, goals, or milestones during the static test program.

children.title: Description of failure and point of origin of damage
Test article repair details
children.content: including schedule information such as cycling time lost for repairs.

children.title: Time of test failure in terms of flight hours, landings, or pressurizations demonstrated
Inspection Techniques, access information, and recommended nondestructive testing methods if other than visual inspection is required
Recommend repair, rework, or replacement procedures
Sketches and digital images, marked-up if necessary to show appropriate areas of structural damage and repair
